description: Tier C. For repos with no pull_request-triggered CI, or with PR CI that is currently red.
Nothing merges without a human. automerge is already false in the base preset — it is repeated
here so that reading this one file tells you the whole story, and so that a future edit to the
base cannot quietly switch it on for repos that never earned it.
Majors and lockfile refreshes are parked behind the dashboard so the PR list stays short enough
that a red check is actually noticed.

packageRules.description: Majors wait on the dashboard until someone ticks them.
Belt and braces: no rule anywhere may turn on automerge in this tier.
